title: 卡尔玛·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 暖棕肤色衬着绿色额间宝石，肩后弯曲的双龙装饰保留独特形态。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Karma is an adult Ionian woman with warm brown skin, short dark hair, a green forehead jewel, and a distinctive curved twin-dragon ornament behind her shoulders. Preserve her serene focused face and natural adult proportions through a fully covering layered purple-green robe, opaque sleeves, covered legs, and shoes. Any green light remains a restrained ornament, never an attacking beam or spell gesture.
art_direction.scene: A gently elevated three-quarter arrangement, the signature motif nearest the viewer, modest accurate perspective and fresh reflected colors. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: jade green, plum, warm brown, pale gold light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
